violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: BOXES OF SYRUPS AND FLAVORINGS STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR TO RIGHT OF COFFEE BAR IN DINING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE WRAPPED HAIR INTO BUN DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES ARE PROVIDED WITH PROPER HAIR RESTRAINTS AND COMPLY WITH PROPER USE DURING FOOD PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. NO SANITIZER WAS OBSERVED AT START OF INSPECTION. PIC OBTAINED FROM ADJACENT ESTABLISHMENT DURING INSPECTION AND PREPARED SANITIZER BUCKET WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION. PLEASE ENSURE SANITIZER IS PROVIDED AND SANITIZER SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION IS PREPARED AT START OF SHIFT FOR STORING WET WIPING CLOTHS USED FOR WIPING EQUIPMENT SURFACES. Loud'n Roasted Coffee Roasters (Inspection Date: 07/01/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a EITHER BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit SUITABLE FOR SANITIZER PROVIDED FOR USE AT ESTABLISHMENT. PIC USED CHLORINE SANITIZER TEST STRIPS OBTAINED FROM ADJACENT ESTABLISHMENT.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink being used TO STORE SOILED UTENSILS.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASH SINK IS USED ONLY FOR HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: STEAMING PITCHERS WITH ACCUMULATION OF FOOD DEBRIS.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MILK AT 44F IN SANYO 1 DOOR UNDER COUNTER (NITRO/TEA) UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED MILK DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: SANYO 1 DOOR UNDER COUNTER (NITRO) AT 42F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.
